actual_scope: Tiny owned filesystem files, no SDK or archive.
Refused and returning callback swaps preserve original and successor, final destination absent.
Post-link temporary successor remains, complete final retained with explicit uncertainty.
Normal atomic no-replace 0600 publication and exact bytes.
Raw-fd construction/write failures and all-owned-close attempts, no descriptor retry.
Late Git markers and owner/private-mode changes refuse or become uncertain after publication.
limits: No universal guarantee against a hostile concurrent same-UID filesystem writer.
Failure retains private temporary bytes for explicit inspection; no rollback promise.
No SDK, package installation, build, archive creation, network, account, model or daemon execution.
No original requirement, permission, legal/accuracy or attestation acceptance.
Historical whole-helper producer bindings require actual integration refresh; not edited here.
